title: About — identity / profile card
description: A macOS 'About This Mac'-style identity card as an OS app: avatar (or monogram fallback), name, roles, location, a short description, a list of outbound links and an accordion FAQ. The whole card is driven by ONE injected AboutProfile (name / roles[] / location / description / links[{label,href}] / faq[{q,a}] / avatarUrl?): call configureAbout(yourProfile) to wire your own identity, or keep the bundled generic mock person so the card renders fully populated with zero backend.
